entities.name: Listed entities (equity)
entities.profile: Companies with equity shares listed on the main board or SME platform.

entities.name: Listed entities (debt)
entities.profile: Issuers with listed non-convertible debt securities or commercial paper.

entities.name: AMCs and mutual funds
entities.profile: Asset management companies, trustees and mutual fund schemes.

entities.name: AIFs and managers
entities.profile: Alternative Investment Funds of all categories and their managers.

updates.title: Foreign portfolio investors allowed in physically settled non-agricultural commodity derivatives
updates.applies: Foreign portfolio investors, commodity exchanges, clearing corporations and their members.
changes: FPIs may trade physically settled non-agricultural commodity derivatives, with safeguards.
An FPI cannot take fresh positions in the three trading days before the tender period; positions left open pass to its designated trading or clearing member.
In force from 01-06-2027; exchanges and clearing corporations amend their rules before then.

broker.text: Members serving FPIs take on residual positions at expiry; build the process.

actions: Commodity brokers: agree the designated-member arrangement with FPI clients before June 2027.

updates.title: Simplification of client on-boarding and rationalisation of risk management framework at KYC Registration Agencies
updates.applies: All SEBI-registered intermediaries that on-board clients, and KYC Registration Agencies.
changes: Common supplementary client information (such as income range, FATCA/CRS details, PEP status and occupation) is centralised at the KRA, along with CKYC ID, DIGIPIN and the expiry date of the officially valid document.
Intermediaries upload the specified KYC information to the KRA within three working days of completing KYC.
In force from 24-12-2026; KRAs issue an operating procedure within 30 days.

amc.text: Update on-boarding forms and KRA uploads.

actions: Update account opening forms and KRA upload processes before 24-12-2026.

updates.title: Half-yearly review of "Significant Indices": list unchanged
updates.applies: Index providers and asset management companies using the listed indices.
changes: SEBI reviewed the list of significant indices under the Index Providers Regulations, 2024. The list is unchanged.

updates.title: Proposal: early pay-out of funds for Farmer Producer Organisations in commodity derivatives
updates.applies: Commodity exchanges, clearing corporations and members serving Farmer Producer Organisations.
changes: SEBI proposes an early pay-out of funds to Farmer Producer Organisations that deliver on commodity derivative contracts.
Comments are due by 16-12-2026.

broker.text: Relevant to commodity brokers with FPO clients.

updates.title: Advisory against publishing grey market premium for upcoming IPOs
updates.applies: Registered intermediaries, issuers and investors.
changes: SEBI states that the pre-listing or "grey market" premium is unregulated and unreliable.
Registered intermediaries are told not to publish or circulate grey market premium for upcoming public issues.

broker.text: Remove grey market premium from apps, research notes and social media.

equity.text: Issuers and their bankers should not refer to it.

actions: Review websites, apps and social media handles for grey market premium content.

updates.title: Proposal to review the additional disclosure framework for foreign portfolio investors
updates.applies: Foreign portfolio investors, designated depository participants and custodians.
changes: SEBI proposes changes to the rules that require granular ownership disclosures from FPIs with concentrated or large Indian equity holdings.
Comments are due by 11-12-2026.

equity.text: May change which FPI shareholders face disclosure-driven sell-downs.

broker.text: Custody and DDP processes may change.

updates.title: Proposal to strengthen governance of market infrastructure institutions
updates.applies: Stock exchanges, clearing corporations and depositories.
changes: Proposals for public interest directors: maximum age to fall from 75 to 70; at most two terms of three years across all such institutions, down from three; membership of at most four statutory committees.
Changes are also proposed to the tenure of managing directors and executive directors.
Comments are due by 11-12-2026. SEBI issued a clarification on media reports about the paper on 27-11-2026.

updates.title: Review of margin framework for commodity derivatives
updates.applies: Commodity exchanges, clearing corporations and their members.
changes: Minimum initial margin is set at 6%, 8% or 10% according to the commodity's volatility category, for agricultural and non-agricultural commodities.
The margin period of risk is two days for the first two categories and three days for the most volatile.
In force from 01-12-2026 and valid for one year.

broker.text: Margin calls and client funding change from 01-12-2026.

actions: Commodity brokers: update margin files and tell clients before 01-12-2026.

updates.title: Sub-group formed to review parts of the ICDR Regulations
updates.applies: Issuers, merchant bankers and investors in public and rights issues.
changes: A sub-group of the Primary Market Advisory Committee will review Chapters II, IIA, IV, V and VI of the ICDR Regulations, 2018.
No rule changes yet; proposals would follow as a consultation paper.

equity.text: Watch for proposals on IPOs, rights issues and preferential issues.

updates.title: FATCA and CRS reporting revised under the Income-Tax Act, 2025 and Income-Tax Rules, 2026
updates.applies: Registered intermediaries that are Reporting Financial Institutions.
changes: Reporting and due diligence now follow s. 508 of the Income-Tax Act, 2025 and rules 238 to 240 and Form 166 of the Income-Tax Rules, 2026.
Self-certification, controlling person and account classification systems must capture the new fields; FATCA/CRS certifications are uploaded to the KRA.

amc.text: Update FATCA/CRS self-certification and Form 166 reporting.

actions: Review on-boarding and reporting systems for the new mandatory fields.

updates.title: SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 in force
updates.applies: Anyone facing or likely to face SEBI proceedings.
changes: Replace the Settlement Proceedings Regulations, 2018.
Settlement notices before a show cause notice, a formula-based settlement amount, and fast track settlement for delayed or wrong-format disclosures.
Applications within 90 days of a show cause notice; pending cases not settled under the 2018 rules may apply within 90 days at a 20% higher amount.

equity.text: New route and costs for settling disclosure defaults.

actions: Check any pending show cause notices against the 90-day window.

updates.title: Consultation paper: AML/CFT certification for Principal Officers of intermediaries
updates.applies: All intermediaries registered under s. 12 of the SEBI Act.
changes: Proposes a mandatory AML/CFT certification for the Principal Officer responsible for PMLA compliance.
No rule has changed yet.

amc.text: Principal Officer may need to certify.

updates.title: Review of the framework for Accredited Investors
updates.applies: AIF managers, SIF AMCs and portfolio managers, and their investors.
changes: Managers may determine and record an investor's accredited status themselves, valid for three years and recognised across the same group.
Securities market exposure qualifies: at least Rs 5 crore for individuals, HUFs, family trusts and sole proprietorships, and Rs 20 crore for bodies corporate and other trusts.

aif.text: New manager-led accreditation route and exposure-based criteria.

actions: Set up a documented accreditation process if using the manager route.

updates.title: Framework for net settlement of funds for mutual fund cash market transactions
updates.applies: Mutual funds, custodians, stock brokers and clearing corporations.
changes: Funds for outright transactions in the cash segment may be settled net at the level of each scheme; securities still settle gross.
No netting across schemes. In force from 01-04-2027.

amc.text: Operational change for scheme-level fund settlement.

broker.text: Settlement processes with mutual fund clients change.

updates.title: Currency derivatives: single USD 5 million limit without establishing underlying exposure
updates.applies: Stock exchanges, clearing corporations, members and clients trading exchange-traded currency derivatives.
changes: Domestic clients and foreign portfolio investors may take positions up to USD 5 million (notional, outstanding at any time), across all rupee currency pairs and all exchanges together, without having to establish that an underlying exposure exists.
Follows RBI's A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 25 of 10-10-2026.

broker.text: Update position monitoring and client declarations.

actions: Brokers: change limit monitoring to the combined USD 5 million test.

updates.title: Comprehensive FAQs on the Insider Trading Regulations
updates.applies: Listed companies, their designated persons, intermediaries and fiduciaries.
changes: SEBI published a consolidated set of FAQs on the Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015.
FAQs give SEBI's view and do not amend the regulations.

equity.text: Check the code of conduct, trading window and pre-clearance practice against the FAQs.

actions: Compliance officers: compare the insider trading code with the FAQs.

updates.title: Review of KYC process for individual Person Resident Outside India clients
updates.applies: Intermediaries on-boarding NRI, OCI and foreign national individual clients.
changes: Digital KYC is allowed for individual clients located in FATF-compliant countries, without being in India.
Intermediaries may rely on KYC by another SEBI or financial sector regulated entity through KRA or CKYCRR records.

broker.text: Digital on-boarding of non-resident individuals opens up.

updates.title: Working group to review the Innovators Growth Platform
updates.applies: Start-ups, their investors and merchant bankers.
changes: SEBI set up a working group to review the framework for listing on the Innovators Growth Platform.
No rule changes yet.

aif.text: May widen exit routes for portfolio companies.

updates.title: Cooling-off period for offer for sale by privately listed InvITs
updates.applies: Privately listed InvITs, their sponsors and unitholders, and stock exchanges.
changes: Where units are illiquid, the cooling-off period before and after an offer for sale is eight weeks.
The offer stays open for one day.

debt.text: Relevant to InvIT sponsors and investors planning exits.

updates.title: Frameworks for depository receipts on units of InvITs and REITs
updates.applies: Listed InvITs and REITs, their managers, custodians and depositories.
changes: Listed InvITs and REITs may have depository receipts issued on their units and listed on an international exchange in a permissible jurisdiction.
The underlying units are held by a domestic custodian, and the trust must meet eligibility conditions.
A parallel circular of the same date covers REITs.

debt.text: A new overseas fund-raising route for InvITs and REITs.

updates.title: Extension of timeline for digital accessibility compliance
updates.applies: All SEBI regulated entities.
changes: Appointment of an accessibility auditor, the accessibility audit of digital platforms and fixing its findings are extended to 31-01-2027.

updates.title: Further extension for debenture trustees to move non-SEBI activities to separate business units
updates.applies: Debenture trustees.
changes: The deadline to comply with regulation 9C and the separate business unit framework moves to 27-04-2027 while an expert group reviews it.

updates.title: Closing Auction Session, market timings and settlement methodology for derivatives
updates.applies: Stock exchanges, clearing corporations and stock brokers.
changes: Changes to the closing auction session, market timings and the settlement price method for derivatives; parts take effect from 07-12-2026.

broker.text: Trading and risk systems need changes.

updates.title: SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026
updates.applies: AIFs, their managers and investors.
changes: Accredited investors may now be accredited by a specified SEBI-registered entity, and securities market exposure becomes a qualifying test.
Regulation 25 on dispute resolution between investors and the AIF or manager is substituted.

aif.text: Update accreditation and dispute resolution terms in fund documents.

actions: Review PPM and contribution agreement dispute clauses.

updates.title: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026
updates.applies: Entities that list non-convertible debt securities.
changes: Regulation 62A(1) substituted: an entity whose non-convertible debt securities are listed on or after 14-10-2026 must list all non-convertible debt securities it issues after that listing.
Regulation 62A(2) and (3) omitted.

debt.text: Later debt issues must also be listed once a first listing happens on or after 14-10-2026.

actions: Plan future NCD issues on the basis that they will be listed.

updates.title: Consultation paper: review of ICDR provisions on SME IPOs
updates.applies: SME issuers and merchant bankers.
changes: Working group recommendations to revise the SME IPO framework.
No rule has changed yet.

updates.title: Consultation paper: monitoring and disclosure of utilisation of issue proceeds (LODR review)
updates.applies: Listed entities raising funds.
changes: Working group recommendations on monitoring agency reports and disclosure of how issue proceeds are used.
No rule has changed yet.

equity.text: Possible new disclosure on use of proceeds.

updates.title: SEBI (Intermediaries) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026: common advertisement code
updates.applies: Regulated entities that advertise, including AMCs, stock brokers and AIF managers.
changes: New Chapter IIID sets a common advertisement code, including rules on celebrity endorsements and influencers.
In force 180 days after publication on 09-10-2026. The MF Regulations' own advertisement schedule is removed by a matching amendment.

amc.text: Mutual fund advertising moves to the common code.

actions: Review advertising and celebrity or influencer arrangements before the code takes effect.

updates.title: SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2026
updates.applies: Portfolio managers, including AMCs that offer portfolio management services.
changes: New regulations replace the Portfolio Managers Regulations, 2020 from 01-04-2027.

amc.text: AMCs running portfolio management services must move to the new rules by 01-04-2027.

updates.title: Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt securities
updates.applies: Issuers of debt securities and online bond platform providers.
changes: A colour-coded Credit Risk-o-Meter becomes mandatory in offer documents, abridged prospectuses, private placement memoranda, issuer advertisements and online bond platforms.
In force 45 days after issue.

debt.text: Add the Credit Risk-o-Meter to offer documents and advertisements.

updates.title: No mandatory merchant banker for certain private placements of debt by listed regulated issuers
updates.applies: Listed issuers regulated by SEBI, RBI, IRDAI or PFRDA issuing debt of Rs 10,000 face value on private placement.
changes: Such issuers may skip the merchant banker if they meet all the conditions, including at least one year of listing and no pending fines.

debt.text: Lower cost for small-ticket private placements by regulated listed issuers.

updates.title: More ISINs for privately placed debt securities
updates.applies: Issuers of privately placed debt securities.
changes: Up to 17 ISINs may mature in a financial year (12 plain vanilla, 5 structured and similar), plus six for capital gains bonds, with extra ISINs for large issuers.

updates.title: Investor awareness messages on stock brokers' websites and apps (Project Jagrook)
updates.applies: Stock brokers.
changes: From 01-11-2026, investor awareness messages shared by SEBI go on the landing page of brokers' websites, and alternate with risk disclosures on trading apps.
actions: Confirm the messages are live on the website and app landing pages.

updates.title: Master Circular for Debenture Trustees
updates.applies: Debenture trustees and issuers of listed debt.
changes: Consolidates the circulars for debenture trustees.

debt.text: Check information flows to the debenture trustee against the consolidated text.

updates.title: More time for older angel funds to move to accredited investors only
updates.applies: Angel funds registered on or before 10-09-2025.
changes: The accredited-investor-only deadline moves from 08-09-2026 to 31-03-2027; up to 200 non-accredited investors may be offered deals until then.

aif.text: New deadline 31-03-2027 for older angel funds.
